## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-sd-incoterms-srv-example`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 5: Save the connection

## Step 6: Set actual values for your configurables

1. In the left panel of WSO2 Integrator, select **Configurations** (listed at the bottom of the project tree, under Data Mappers).
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project sap-s4hana-api-sd-incoterms-srv-example --expect sapHostname,sapUsername,sapPassword` to set the configurable values.
